description: Use this whenever you need a password, API key, 2FA key or other secret from the person, instead of asking in chat. It returns a one-time link; what they type there is locked in their browser for this vault. Then call wait_for_secret.

fields.description: What to ask for, like ["email", "password"]. Defaults to ["password"]. A field named "totp" asks for a 2FA setup key.

name.description: What the secret is for. The person sees it as the title, like "Netflix" or "OpenAI API key"

name: request_secret
title: Ask for a secret
